content_sections.heading: IBPS RRB Vacancy 2026 - Post-Wise Details
content_sections.text: IBPS has released indicative, RRB-wise and category-wise vacancies for each post in Annexure-I of the notification. The notification itself does not print a single consolidated grand-total figure; the totals below are computed by summing the individual state/RRB-wise tables for each post category. One participating bank, Tripura Gramin Bank , has reported "NR" (Not Reported) against every post, so it is excluded from these computed totals and the true final vacancy count will be higher once that figure is released. Vacancies are spread across all 28 participating RRBs, covering states such as Andhra Pradesh, Bihar, Gujarat, Karnataka, Maharashtra, Uttar Pradesh, West Bengal, and others. Candidates can check the RRB-wise, category-wise (SC/ST/OBC/EWS/General) breakup for their state directly in Annexure-I of the official notification, since a state/category-level reproduction is too extensive for this summary.

content_sections.text: Nationality: a candidate must be a citizen of India, or a subject of Nepal/Bhutan, or a Tibetan refugee who arrived before 1 January 1962 intending to settle permanently in India, or a person of Indian origin migrated from certain specified countries with an eligibility certificate from the Government of India. Educational qualification (as on the last date of online registration, i.e. 21.09.2026) varies by post: Candidates awarded CGPA/OGPA must convert it to a percentage as per their university's own conversion criteria, and the result for the qualifying degree must have been declared on or before 21.09.2026.

content_sections.heading: IBPS RRB Age Limit
content_sections.text: Age is reckoned as on 01.09.2026. Age relaxation is available as follows: 5 years for SC/ST, 3 years for OBC (non-creamy layer), 10 years for Persons with Benchmark Disability (PwBD), and additional relaxation for Ex-Servicemen and (for Office Assistant only) widows, divorced women, and women legally separated from their husbands who have not remarried. Relaxation for SC/ST/OBC is cumulative with only one other applicable category. Candidates are advised to check whether they satisfy the prescribed age limit before applying. Use our online Age Calculator to calculate your exact age instantly.

content_sections.heading: IBPS RRB Application Fee
content_sections.text: Payment is online only, between 01.09.2026 and 21.09.2026. Bank transaction charges for online payment are to be borne by the candidate. A candidate applying for both an Officer post and the Office Assistant post must pay the fee separately for each.

content_sections.heading: IBPS RRB Salary & Exam Pattern
content_sections.text: Salary: Not specified in the notification. Exam pattern: The online examination structure differs by post and stage. There is a penalty of 0.25 marks for each wrong answer in the objective tests; unattempted questions are not penalised. Officer Scale-II candidates sit for a single-level examination (structure not itemised separately in the notification excerpt reviewed here beyond the general pattern above).

faq.question: Q1. What is IBPS RRB Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: IBPS RRB Recruitment 2026 is the Common Recruitment Process (CRP RRBs-XV) conducted by the Institute of Banking Personnel Selection for recruitment of Office Assistant (Multipurpose) and Officer Scale-I, II and III posts in Regional Rural Banks.

faq.question: Q2. When will IBPS RRB Recruitment 2026 online application start?
faq.answer: The online application process for IBPS RRB Recruitment 2026 will start on 01 September 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for IBPS RRB Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application and pay the application fee/intimation charges is 21 September 2026.

faq.question: Q4. Which posts are available under IBPS RRB CRP XV 2026?
faq.answer: The recruitment includes Office Assistant (Multipurpose), Officer Scale-I (Assistant Manager), Officer Scale-II (Manager) and Officer Scale-III (Senior Manager) posts.

faq.question: Q5. What is the qualification required for IBPS RRB Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates generally need a Bachelor's Degree or relevant professional qualification depending on the post. Officer Scale-II and III posts also require prescribed qualifications and work experience.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for IBPS RRB Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The age limit varies by post. It is 18 to 28 years for Office Assistant, above 18 and below 30 years for Officer Scale-I, above 21 and below 32 years for Officer Scale-II, and above 21 and below 40 years for Officer Scale-III. Applicable age relaxation will be provided as per IBPS rules.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for IBPS RRB Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Office Assistant candidates will undergo Preliminary and Main examinations. Officer Scale-I candidates will have Preliminary, Main and Interview stages, while Officer Scale-II and III candidates will appear for a Single Online Examination followed by an Interview.

faq.question: Q8. When will the IBPS RRB 2026 exams be conducted?
faq.answer: Officer Scale-I Preliminary Exam is scheduled for 21 and 22 November 2026. Office Assistant Preliminary Exam will be held on 06, 12 and 13 December 2026. The Officer Scale-I Main and Officer Scale-II/III Single Exam are scheduled for 20 December 2026, while the Office Assistant Main Exam is scheduled for 30 January 2027.

faq.question: Q9. How many vacancies are available in IBPS RRB Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: An indicative 13,706 posts across all RRBs and post categories, computed from the state-wise Annexure-I tables. This is a computed figure since one bank (Tripura Gramin Bank) has not yet reported its numbers, and vacancies may change based on the RRBs' actual reported requirement.

faq.question: Q10. Can I apply for more than one IBPS RRB post?
faq.answer: Yes - a candidate can apply for the Office Assistant post and also for one Officer post (Scale-I, II, or III), but only one post within the Officer cadre. Fees must be paid separately for each post applied for.
